name: Ichina
source: Hidaka Ichina when she was a child. She only has some of her adult memories really faintly. She was sent into Bullet Butler's world, "Gold Rock" to pursue a completely different faith than what normally lies ahead of her. A young girl shouldering immense crimes since she was born.
